headline: Deutsche Telekom raises 2026 targets following Q3 results
summary: Deutsche Telekom has increased its financial targets for 2026 after reporting third-quarter results. The company also announced a share buyback program, though the scale of the buyback fell short of analyst expectations.
why: Deutsche Telekom is one of Europe's largest telecommunications companies. Its financial outlook is a bellwether for the European telecom sector.

impacts.name: Deutsche Telekom
impacts.why: Higher targets are positive, but buybacks below expectations can dampen investor enthusiasm.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Market reaction is often mixed when positive guidance is offset by capital allocation decisions, such as buybacks, that fail to meet consensus estimates.
